notes: Split out from Workbook #10 (Sept 30) at Adrian's request Oct 16 so each channel is its own action item. Bobby executes under Kevin: AI finds and drafts, Bobby opens, claims/creates, verifies, and reports the live URL. Improve an existing profile rather than create a duplicate. Yelp penalizes solicited reviews, so do not ask customers for Yelp reviews (yelp-support.com, 'Don't Ask for Reviews'). Claim via biz.yelp.com. Status codes: Not checked, Existing, Access needed, Draft ready, Verification pending, Complete (live URL + evidence of company control). Mark Done only with the live URL in this thread.
prompt: I am Kevin Doud, owner of KMD Analytical. Help me complete and optimize KMD Analytical's Yelp profile. Use the approved brand book, the actual vial and logo artwork, the current service descriptions and verified business facts (KMD Group LLC dba KMD Analytical, 9631 Topanga Canyon Pl, Chatsworth, CA 91311, kmdanalytical.com once confirmed canonical). First search for an existing Yelp listing and give me candidate URLs and why they match; do not assume no result means no account. I will open Yelp, confirm ownership, and claim, recover or create it. Then draft every field within Yelp's current limits: name, categories, description, services, website and contact links, address, hours, photos and call to action where supported. Leave missing facts as questions. Suggest image sizes for the real logo and banner. No invented accreditation, FDA registration, rankings, review counts, turnaround promises or medical claims. Yelp penalizes solicited reviews, so do not ask customers for Yelp reviews (yelp-support.com, 'Don't Ask for Reviews'). Claim via biz.yelp.com. Finish with a paste-ready field checklist, link-test checklist, verification steps, and a one-line status for the profile register: URL, handle, admin, recovery contact, status, evidence, next step (no passwords).
title: Profiles: Yelp — find and claim the existing listing or create one; complete facts, categories and photos; never solicit Yelp reviews
